raw_text: Myanmar's military junta conducted airstrikes in Chin State's Falam and Tedim townships on Wednesday, with some strikes landing within five kilometres of the Indian border. Residents in Mizoram's Champhai district reported hearing loud explosions in the early morning hours. The Chin National Front confirmed that junta forces targeted resistance-held positions near Rihkhawdar. Local NGOs in Mizoram report approximately 200 new arrivals seeking refuge since the strikes began.
clean_text: Myanmar junta airstrikes in Falam and Tedim, Chin State, within 5km of Indian border. Champhai residents heard explosions. About 200 refugees arrived in Mizoram.
